Fetch genotypes for a region of the genome

Source: R/fetch.R
fetch_region.Rd

Downloads the genotypes of the 2,504 unrelated people in the 1000 Genomes Project for one or more regions of the genome, and returns them as a snpscape object ready for analysis.

Usage

fetch_region(regions, flank = 25000, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

regions

A character vector of gene symbols and/or coordinates.

flank

Number of base pairs to add on each side of a gene. Ignored for coordinates.

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

A snpscape object (see snpscape).

Details

What you can ask for

Each element of regions can be:

  • a gene symbol, such as "LCT" or "MC1R". The gene is looked up with find_gene() and flank base pairs are added on each side, because variants that regulate a gene often lie just outside it.

  • a set of coordinates on the GRCh38 assembly, such as "chr2:135787850-135862184". The chr prefix and commas are optional, so "2:135,787,850-135,862,184" also works.

Only the autosomes (chromosomes 1 to 22) are supported. Large regions take longer and need more memory: a 1 Mb region typically holds around 25,000 SNPs.

What you get

Only biallelic SNPs are kept: positions where exactly two DNA letters are seen in the population (for example G and A). Insertions, deletions, larger structural variants, and positions with more than two alleles are dropped, because the analyses in this package assume each variant has exactly two forms.

Each person's genotype at a SNP is stored as the number of copies of the alternative allele (alt) they carry: 0, 1 or 2. The reference allele (ref) is simply the letter found in the human reference genome; it is not necessarily the ancestral or the most common allele.

The 698 relatives (mostly children of parent pairs) who are also in the high-coverage panel are not included, because close relatives share long stretches of DNA and would distort population analyses.

Caching

Fetched regions are saved on disk, so fetching the same region again is instant and works offline. See clear_cache().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lct <- fetch_region("LCT")
lct

# several regions at once
pigmentation <- fetch_region(c("MC1R", "SLC24A5"))

# a stretch of chromosome 18 with no well-known genes under selection
neutral <- fetch_region("chr18:1000000-1500000")
} # }
